data.spec: Source packages/contracts/src/index.ts (DeviceEventSchema), portable export packages/contracts/device-event.schema.json. DeviceEvent = {event_id: nonempty string <=128, station_id:'kitchen'|'bathroom'|'printer', type:'button_pressed'|'speech_transcript'|'stock_low', timestamp:ISO datetime, payload:{text?:nonempty string <=2000,item_id?:string <=128,level?:number 0..100}}. speech_transcript requires text; stock_low requires item_id. Reuse event_id for retries. POST /api/device-events → EventResponse {request:OfficeRequest,duplicate:boolean,command:DeviceCommand}. Raw Atech telemetry is a separate upstream format, normalized by the bridge.
